text.zh: 与航天飞行（例如亚轨道、轨道、月球、行星际或其他超出地球轨道的飞行）乘客或参与者体验直接相关或为其所必需的活动及技术/技术数据，无论该体验用于太空旅游、科学或商业研究、商业制造/生产活动、教育、媒体或商业运输，均不受ITAR或EAR管辖。此类活动及技术/技术数据包括与以下事项直接相关或为其所必需的活动及技术/技术数据：
text.en: Activities and technology/technical data directly related to or required for the spaceflight (e.g., sub-orbital, orbital, lunar, interplanetary, or otherwise beyond Earth orbit) passenger or participant experience, regardless of whether the passenger or participant experience is for space tourism, scientific or commercial research, commercial manufacturing/production activities, educational, media, or commercial transportation purposes, are not subject to the ITAR or the EAR. Such activities and technology/technical data include those directly related to or required for:

text.zh: (i) 接近、进入和离开“航天器”，包括操作“航天器”的所有舱门、舱口和气闸；
text.en: (i) “Spacecraft” access, ingress, and egress, including the operation of all “spacecraft” doors, hatches, and airlocks;

text.zh: (ii) 生理训练（例如载人离心机训练或抛物线飞行、压力服或航天服的训练/操作）；
text.en: (ii) Physiological training (e.g., human-rated centrifuge training or parabolic flights, pressure suit or spacesuit training/operation);

text.zh: (iii) 对航天飞行乘客或参与者进行医学评价或评估；
text.en: (iii) Medical evaluation or assessment of the spaceflight passenger or participant;

text.zh: (iv) 对乘客或参与者进行健康和安全相关硬件或应急程序的培训，以及由其操作该硬件或执行应急程序；硬件包括座椅、环境控制与生命保障系统、卫生设施、食物制备设备、健身设备、灭火设备、通信设备、安全相关服装或头部防护用品；
text.en: (iv) Training for and operation by the passenger or participant of health and safety related hardware (e.g., seating, environmental control and life support, hygiene facilities, food preparation, exercise equipment, fire suppression, communications equipment, safety-related clothing or headgear) or emergency procedures;

text.zh: (v) 观看航天器或地面模型的内部和外部；
text.en: (v) Viewing of the interior and exterior of the spacecraft or terrestrial mock-ups;

text.zh: (vi) 观察“航天器”的运行（例如飞行前检查、着陆和飞行中状态）；
text.en: (vi) Observing “spacecraft” operations (e.g., pre-flight checks, landing, in-flight status);

text.zh: (vii) 在“航天器”或地面模型内，接受连接或操作乘客或参与者设备的培训，而该设备用于操作“航天器”以外的目的；或
text.en: (vii) Training in “spacecraft” or terrestrial mock-ups for connecting to or operating passenger or participant equipment used for purposes other than operating the “spacecraft”; or

text.zh: (viii) 穿上、穿戴或使用乘客或参与者的飞行服、压力服或航天服及个人装备。
text.en: (viii) Donning, wearing or utilizing the passenger's or participant's flight suit, pressure suit or spacesuit, and personal equipment.

text.zh: b. 以下任何物项的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的“技术”（“按图制造技术”除外）：
text.en: b. “Technology” (other than “build-to-print technology”) “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 静止结构构件；
text.en: b.1. Static structural members;

text.zh: b.2. 外蒙皮、可拆卸整流罩、不可拆卸整流罩、雷达罩、检修门和面板以及可在飞行中打开的门；
text.en: b.2. Exterior skins, removable fairings, non-removable fairings, radomes, access doors and panels, and in-flight opening doors;

text.zh: b.3. 操纵面、前缘、后缘和前缘襟翼密封件；
text.en: b.3. Control surfaces, leading edges, trailing edges, and leading edge flap seals;

text.zh: b.4. 为USML第VIII类所管制战斗机、攻击机或轰炸机“专门设计”的前缘襟翼作动系统商品（即动力驱动单元、旋转齿轮作动器、扭矩管、不对称制动器、位置传感器和角齿轮箱）；
text.en: b.4. Leading edge flap actuation system commodities (i.e., power drive units, rotary geared actuators, torque tubes, asymmetry brakes, position sensors, and angle gearboxes) “specially designed” for fighter, attack, or bomber aircraft controlled in USML Category VIII;

text.zh: b.5. 发动机进气口和管道；
text.en: b.5. Engine inlets and ducting;

text.zh: b.6. 为将实际使用情况与分析或设计载荷谱相关联并计算疲劳寿命量而“专门设计”、且为USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制航空器“专门设计”的疲劳寿命监测系统，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
text.en: b.6. Fatigue life monitoring systems “specially designed” to relate actual usage to the analytical or design spectrum and to compute amount of fatigue life “specially designed” for aircraft controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

text.zh: b.7. 为用于USML第VIII(a)子类或ECCN 9A610.a所管制、重量超过21,000磅的航空器而“专门设计”的起落架及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”，但军用商业衍生型航空器除外；
text.en: b.7. Landing gear, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, “specially designed” for use in aircraft weighing more than 21,000 pounds controlled by either USML subcategory VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a, except for Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft;

text.zh: b.8. 保形油箱及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；
text.en: b.8. Conformal fuel tanks and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor;

text.zh: b.9. 为符合MIL-STD-461要求的航空器提供电磁干扰（EMI）防护（即传导发射、辐射发射、传导敏感度和辐射敏感度防护）而“专门设计”的电气“设备”、“零件”和“部件”；
text.en: b.9. Electrical “equipment,” “parts,” and “components” “specially designed” for electro-magnetic interference (EMI)—i.e., conducted emissions, radiated emissions, conducted susceptibility and radiated susceptibility—protection of aircraft that conform to the requirements of MIL-STD-461;

text.zh: b.10. HOTAS（双手不离油门和驾驶杆）操纵装置、HOCAS（双手不离总距杆和驾驶杆）操纵装置、主动操纵输入系统（即主动侧杆控制组件、主动油门操纵台组件和操纵输入控制单元的组合）、用于数字飞行控制系统的方向舵脚蹬组件，以及为其“专门设计”的零件和部件；
text.en: b.10. HOTAS (Hand-on Throttle and Stick) controls, HOCAS (Hands on Collective and Stick), Active Inceptor Systems (i.e., a combination of Active Side Stick Control Assembly, Active Throttle Quadrant Assembly, and Inceptor Control Unit), rudder pedal assemblies for digital flight control systems, and parts and components “specially designed” therefor;

text.zh: b.11. 综合载具健康管理系统（IVHMS）、基于状态的维护（CBM）系统和飞行数据监测（FDM）系统；
text.en: b.11. Integrated Vehicle Health Management Systems (IVHMS), Condition Based Maintenance (CBM) Systems, and Flight Data Monitoring (FDM) systems;

text.zh: b.12. 为航空器系统预测与健康管理而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: b.12. Equipment “specially designed” for system prognostic and health management of aircraft;

text.zh: b.13. 主动振动控制系统；
text.en: b.13. Active Vibration Control Systems;

text.zh: b.14. 为通过.50口径或更大口径枪击试验（MIL-DTL-5578、MIL-DTL-27422）而“专门设计”的自封闭燃油囊；或
text.en: b.14. Self-sealing fuel bladders “specially designed” to pass a .50 caliber or larger gunfire test (MIL-DTL-5578, MIL-DTL-27422); or

text.zh: b.15. 9A610.x所管制、且为USML第VIII(h)(7)类所管制损伤或故障自适应飞行控制系统“专门设计”的“零件”或“部件”的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的技术。
text.en: b.15. Technology “required” for the “development” or “production” of “parts” or “components” controlled in 9A610.x and “specially designed” for damage or failure-adaptive flight control systems controlled in Category VIII(h)(7) of the USML.

text.en: b. “Technology” (other than “build-to-print technology”) “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 前框架、涡轮中间框架和排气框架；
text.en: b.1. Front, turbine center, and exhaust frames;

text.zh: b.2. 以下低压压气机（即风扇）“部件”和“零件”：整流锥和机匣；
text.en: b.2. Low pressure compressor (i.e., fan) “components” and “parts” as follows: Nose cones and casings;

text.zh: b.3. 以下高压压气机“部件”和“零件”：机匣；
text.en: b.3. High pressure compressor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings;

text.zh: b.4. 以下燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、燃油喷嘴、旋流器、旋流杯、消旋器、阀式喷射器和点火器；
text.en: b.4. Combustor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings, fuel nozzles, swirlers, swirler cups, deswirlers, valve injectors, and igniters;

text.zh: b.5. 以下高压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣
text.en: b.5. High pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings

text.zh: b.6. 以下低压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：机匣；
text.en: b.6. Low pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings;

text.zh: b.7. 以下加力燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：机匣、火焰稳定器、喷油杆、引燃燃烧器、加力燃油控制装置、调节片（外部、收敛和扩张调节片）、导向环和同步环，以及火焰探测器和传感器；
text.en: b.7. Augmentor “components” and “parts” as follows: Casings, flame holders, spray bars, pilot burners, augmentor fuel controls, flaps (external, convergent, and divergent), guide and syncronization rings, and flame detectors and sensors;

text.zh: b.8. 以下机械“部件”和“零件”：燃油计量装置和燃油泵计量装置、阀门（燃油节流阀、主计量阀、滑油流量管理阀）、热交换器（空气/空气、燃油/空气、燃油/滑油）、碎屑监测装置（进气和排气）、密封件（碳密封、迷宫密封、刷式密封、平衡活塞密封和“刀刃式”密封）、永磁交流发电机和发电机、涡流传感器；
text.en: b.8. Mechanical “components” and “parts” as follows: Fuel metering units and fuel pump metering units, valves (fuel throttle, main metering, oil flow management), heat exchangers (air/air, fuel/air, fuel/oil), debris monitoring (inlet and exhaust), seals (carbon, labyrinth, brush, balance piston, and “knife-edge”), permanent magnetic alternator and generator, eddy current sensors;

text.zh: b.9. 扭矩计组件（即壳体、轴、基准轴和套筒）；或
text.en: b.9. Torquemeter assembly (i.e., housing, shaft, reference shaft, and sleeve); or

text.zh: b.10. ECCN 9C619.b所管制的材料。
text.en: b.10. Materials controlled by ECCN 9C619.b.

text.zh: c. 以下任何物项的“开发”或“生产”“所必需”的“技术”：
text.en: c. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 以下低压压气机（即风扇）“部件”和“零件”：叶片、导向叶片、转子、护环、整体叶盘、轴和盘；
text.en: c.1. Low pressure compressor (i.e., fan) “components” and “parts” as follows: blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts and disks;

text.zh: c.2. 以下高压压气机“部件”和“零件”：叶片、导向叶片、转子、护环、整体叶盘、轴、盘和叶轮；
text.en: c.2. High pressure compressor “components” and “parts” as follows: blades, vanes, spools, shrouds, blisks, shafts, disks, and impellers;

text.zh: c.3. 以下燃烧室“部件”和“零件”：扩压器、火焰筒、燃烧腔、罩壳、头部和壳体；
text.en: c.3. Combustor “components” and “parts” as follows: diffusers, liners, chambers, cowlings, domes and shells;

text.zh: c.4. 以下高压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：轴和盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴及叶尖护环；
text.en: c.4. High pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: shafts and disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, tip shrouds;

text.zh: c.5. 以下低压涡轮“部件”和“零件”：轴和盘、叶片、导向叶片、喷嘴及叶尖护环；
text.en: c.5. Low pressure turbine “components” and “parts” as follows: shafts and disks, blades, vanes, nozzles, tip shrouds;

text.zh: c.6. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机“专门设计”的数字发动机控制系统，例如全权限数字发动机控制系统（FADEC）和数字电子发动机控制系统（DEEC）；或
text.en: c.6. Digital engine control systems (e.g., Full Authority Digital Engine Controls (FADEC) and Digital Electronic Engine Controls (DEEC)) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines controlled in this ECCN; or

text.zh: c.7. 为本ECCN所管制燃气涡轮发动机及部件“专门设计”的发动机监测系统，即预测、诊断和健康监测系统。
text.en: c.7. Engine monitoring systems (i.e., prognostics, diagnostics, and health) “specially designed” for gas turbine engines and components controlled in this ECCN.

text.en: § 774.1 Introduction.

text.zh: (a) 管制清单的范围。本部分提及EAR，均指《联邦法规》第15编第VII章C分章。工业与安全局（BIS）管理商业管制清单（CCL），其中包括受BIS权限管辖的“物项”，即“商品”“软件”和“技术”。CCL不包括由美国政府其他部门或机构专属实施出口管制的物项；但其他机构对相关物项实施管制时，CCL条目可载有对这些管制的交叉引用。此外，“受EAR管辖”但未列于CCL的物项，以“EAR99”标识。“受EAR管辖”的物项见EAR §734.2(a)。EAR第738部分说明CCL的编排方式及其与国家表的关系。
text.en: (a) Scope of the control list. In this part, references to the EAR are references to 15 CFR chapter VII, subchapter C. The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) maintains the Commerce Control List (CCL) that includes “items”—i.e., “commodities,” “software,” and “technology”—subject to the authority of BIS. The CCL does not include items exclusively controlled for export by another department or agency of the U.S. Government, though in instances where other agencies administer controls over related items, entries in the CCL may contain a reference to such controls. In addition, those items “subject to the EAR” but not identified on the CCL are identified by the designator “EAR99.” See § 734.2(a) of the EAR for items that are “subject to the EAR.” EAR Part 738 contains an explanation of the organization of the CCL and its relationship to the Country Chart.

text.zh: (b) 对受其他机构专属管辖物项的ECCN交叉引用。
text.en: (b) ECCN cross-references for items subject to exclusive jurisdiction of another agency.

text.zh: (1) 2013年10月15日之前，CCL包含某些ECCN，其列入目的仅为交叉引用受核管理委员会所实施出口管制法规管辖的物项。
text.en: (1) Prior to October 15, 2013, the CCL contained certain ECCNs that were only included as cross references to items subject to the export control regulations administered by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

(2) ECCNs formerly listed on the CCL that, as of October 15, 2013 were subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission at 10 CFR part 110 are: 0A001, 0B001, 0B002, 0B003, 0B004, 0B005, 0B006, 0C001, 0C002, 0C004, 0C005, 0C006, 0C201 and 1C012.

text.zh: (3) 以下多边出口管制机制引用另作历史参考：0C201——INFCIRC 254第1部分，5.3.1(b)。
text.en: (3) The following multilateral export control regime reference is provided, as an additional point of historical reference: 0C201—INFCIRC 254 Part 1, 5.3.1(b).

text.zh: (b)款注：
text.en: Note to paragraph (b):

text.zh: ECCN 0D001和0E001“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编第120至130部分）。这些ECCN作为ITAR的交叉引用保留在CCL中；但自2014年6月5日起，原先在这两个ECCN“许可要求”部分“管制”段落中，对ECCN 0D001所列核管理委员会出口许可权限（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）及对0E001所列能源部权限（见第10编第810部分）的交叉引用已予删除，改为在这两个ECCN新增的标题注中列出较一般性的管辖权交叉引用。
text.en: ECCNs 0D001 and 0E001 are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130). These ECCNs are retained on the CCL as cross references to the ITAR, although the former cross references to export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110) for ECCN 0D001, and to the Department of Energy (see 10 CFR part 810) for 0E001 were removed from the Control(s) paragraph in the License Requirements section of these two ECCNs and added as a more general jurisdictional cross reference in a heading note added to these two ECCNs as of June 5, 2014.

text.zh: (c) 在何处查阅CCL？CCL载于本部分补充文件第1号；本部分补充文件第2号载有与CCL条目有关的技术总注和软件总注。
text.en: (c) Where to find the CCL? The CCL is contained in supplement no. 1 to this part, and supplement no. 2 to this part contains the General Technology and Software Notes relevant to entries contained in the CCL.

text.zh: (d) CCL引号的使用惯例。CCL使用双引号，旨在提醒读者：有关术语已在第772部分（术语定义）中定义；或者，就ECCN而言，定义载于ECCN“许可要求”部分的“相关定义”段落，有时也载于特定ECCN的注和技术注中，且该定义仅适用于相应ECCN。从这一意义上说，单引号和双引号均有提示作用；但良好的合规做法是熟悉第772部分的定义术语，在审查CCL管制参数中未加引号的术语时，也应注意该术语可能已在第772部分定义。另一项有益的合规做法是查阅“相关定义”段落、注和技术注，以确定有关术语是否针对某一特定ECCN设有定义。
text.en: (d) Conventions related to the use of quotation marks on the CCL. The use of double quotation marks on the CCL is intended to be an aid to alert you to terms used on the CCL that are defined in part 772 (Definitions of Terms), or for purposes of ECCNs, where a definition is provided in the “related definitions” paragraph in the License Requirements section of ECCNs or sometimes in Notes and Technical Notes for particular ECCNs and that definition is specific to that particular ECCN. In this sense the quotes are helpful both in the use of single and double quotes, but a good compliance practice is to familiarize yourself with the defined terms in part 772, and when reviewing a control parameter on the CCL that uses a term that is not in quotes to be aware it may be defined in part 772. It is also a useful compliance practice to review the “Related Definitions” paragraph and Notes and Technical Notes to determine if the term is defined for purposes of a particular ECCN.

text.zh: (1) 双引号的使用。CCL中的术语加双引号，表示第772部分对其设有定义。但未加双引号并不表示该术语未在第772部分定义。由于CCL使用大量第772部分定义的术语，BIS的惯例是对某些关键术语使用双引号，并在为保持与基于多边出口管制机制的条目一致所必需时使用双引号；许多此类条目源于管制清单，尤其是同样采用双引号惯例的瓦森纳安排。但是，鉴于CCL所用定义术语数量较多，为避免特定ECCN中过多词语加引号而妨碍阅读，BIS对某些术语（如物项和商品）不加双引号。该惯例也适用于第772部分“术语定义”中的双引号使用。
text.en: (1) Use of double quotes. If a term on the CCL uses double quotes it means there is a defined term in part 772. However, the absence of double quotes does not mean that a term used on the CCL is not defined in part 772. Because the CCL includes many terms that are defined in part 772, BIS's practice is to use double quotes for certain key terms and to use double quotes when needed for consistency with multilateral export control regime based entries, such as many derived from control lists, in particular for the Wassenaar Arrangement that also uses the double quotes convention. However, because of the large number of defined terms used on the CCL and a desire to avoid hindering readability by placing quotes around too many words used in particular ECCNs, BIS's practice is to not add double quotes around certain terms, such as items and commodities. This convention also applies to the use of double quotes within the Definition of Terms section under part 772.

text.zh: (2) 单引号的使用。CCL也对单引号的使用作出约定。CCL中的单引号表示该术语是在某一特定ECCN语境中定义的术语。该惯例也适用于第772部分“术语定义”中的单引号使用。
text.en: (2) Use of single quotes. The CCL also includes a convention regarding the use of single quotes. Single quotes on the CCL identify a term as a defined term in the context of a particular ECCN. This convention also applies to the use of single quotes within the Definition of Terms section under part 772.

text.zh: (e) 以化学文摘社（CAS）登记号标识的化学品。在某些情况下，化学品以名称和CAS号列示。本清单适用于结构式相同的化学品（包括水合物），不论其名称或CAS号为何。列示CAS号是为了辅助识别特定化学品或混合物，不受命名方式影响。CAS号不能用作唯一标识，因为所列化学品的某些形态具有不同CAS号，含有所列化学品的混合物也可能具有不同CAS号。
text.en: (e) Chemicals identified by Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) number. In some instances chemicals are listed by name and CAS number. The list applies to chemicals of the same structural formula (including hydrates) regardless of name or CAS number. CAS numbers are shown to assist in identifying a particular chemical or mixture, irrespective of nomenclature. CAS numbers cannot be used as unique identifiers because some forms of the listed chemical have different CAS numbers, and mixtures containing a listed chemical may also have different CAS numbers.

text.en: Metals and alloys: Unless provision to the contrary is made, the words “metals” and “alloys” in 1C001 to 1C011 cover crude and semi-fabricated forms, as follows:

text.zh: 原始形态：阳极、球、条（包括带缺口条和线坯条）、坯料、块、初轧坯、压块、饼、阴极、晶体、立方块、小方块、晶粒、颗粒、锭、块团、丸粒、生铁块、粉末、圆片、丸、板坯、坯块、海绵体、棒；
text.en: Crude forms: Anodes, balls, bars (including notched bars and wire bars), billets, blocks, blooms, brickets, cakes, cathodes, crystals, cubes, dice, grains, granules, ingots, lumps, pellets, pigs, powder, rondelles, shot, slabs, slugs, sponge, sticks;

text.zh: 半加工形态（无论是否涂覆、镀覆、钻孔或冲孔）：
text.en: Semi-fabricated forms (whether or not coated, plated, drilled or punched):

text.zh: a. 通过轧制、拉拔、挤压、锻造、冲击挤压、压制、造粒、雾化和研磨加工的锻压或加工材料，即：角材、槽材、圆片、圆盘、粉尘、薄片、箔和金属叶、锻件、厚板、粉末、压制件和冲压件、带材、环、杆（包括裸焊条、盘条和轧制线材）、截面型材、异型材、薄板、条带、管材（包括圆形管坯、方形管坯和空心坯）、拉拔或挤出线材；
text.en: a. Wrought or worked materials fabricated by rolling, drawing, extruding, forging, impact extruding, pressing, graining, atomizing, and grinding, i.e.: angles, channels, circles, discs, dust, flakes, foils and leaf, forging, plate, powder, pressings and stampings, ribbons, rings, rods (including bare welding rods, wire rods, and rolled wire), sections, shapes, sheets, strip, pipe and tubes (including tube rounds, squares, and hollows), drawn or extruded wire;

Technical Notes for 2B001 to 2B009, 2B201, and 2B991 to 2B999:

text.zh: 1. 次级平行轮廓控制轴（例如卧式镗床的w轴，或中心线与主旋转轴平行的次级旋转轴）不计入轮廓控制轴总数。旋转轴不必能够旋转超过360°。旋转轴可由直线装置（例如丝杠或齿轮齿条）驱动。
text.en: 1. Secondary parallel contouring axes, (e.g., the w-axis on horizontal boring mills or a secondary rotary axis the center line of which is parallel to the primary rotary axis) are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. Rotary axes need not rotate over 360°. A rotary axis can be driven by a linear device (e.g., a screw or a rack-and-pinion).

text.zh: 2. 可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴数，是指加工工件时，工件与刀具之间沿其或绕其进行同步且相互关联运动的轴数。不包括机床内部发生其他相对运动所沿或所绕的任何附加轴，例如：
text.en: 2. The number of axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” is the number of axes along or around which, during processing of the workpiece, simultaneous and interrelated motions are performed between the workpiece and a tool. This does not include any additional axes along or around which other relative motions within the machine are performed, such as:

text.zh: 2.a. 磨床中的砂轮修整系统；
text.en: 2.a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines;

text.zh: 2.b. 设计用于安装不同工件的平行旋转轴；
text.en: 2.b. Parallel rotary axes designed for mounting of separate workpieces;

text.zh: 2.c. 设计用于通过卡盘从不同端夹持同一工件并操纵该工件的共线旋转轴。
text.en: 2.c. Co-linear rotary axes designed for manipulating the same workpiece by holding it in a chuck from different ends.

text.zh: 3. 轴的命名应符合国际标准ISO 841:2001《工业自动化系统与集成——机床数控——坐标系和运动命名》。
text.en: 3. Axis nomenclature shall be in accordance with International Standard ISO 841:2001, Industrial automation systems and integration—Numerical control of machines—Coordinate system and motion nomenclature.

text.zh: 4. “倾斜主轴”计为一个旋转轴。
text.en: 4. A “tilting spindle” is counted as a rotary axis.

text.zh: 5. 对每个具体机床型号，可使用“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”替代逐台机床测试，其确定方式如下：
text.en: 5. 'Stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' may be used for each specific machine model as an alternative to individual machine tests, and is determined as follows:

text.zh: 5.a. 从待评估型号中选择五台机床；
text.en: 5.a. Select five machines of a model to be evaluated;

text.zh: 5.b. 根据ISO 230-2:2014测量直线轴重复性（R↑、R↓），并评估这五台机床中每台每根轴的“单向定位重复性”；
text.en: 5.b. Measure the linear axis repeatability (R↑,R↓) according to ISO 230-2:2014 and evaluate “unidirectional positioning repeatability” for each axis of each of the five machines;

text.zh: 5.c. 计算五台机床对应各轴的“单向定位重复性”数值的算术平均值。这些“单向定位重复性”（UPR）算术平均值即成为该型号每根轴的声明值……）（UPR_{X}、UPR_{y}、……）；
text.en: 5.c. Determine the arithmetic mean value of the ”unidirectional positioning repeatability”-values for each axis of all five machines together. These arithmetic mean values “unidirectional positioning repeatability” (UPR) become the stated value of each axis for the model...) (UPR_{X}, UPR_{y}, . . .);

text.zh: 5.d. 由于第2类清单逐一涉及各直线轴，因此有多少根直线轴，就有多少个“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”值；
text.en: 5.d. Since the Category 2 list refers to each linear axis there will be as many 'stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' values as there are linear axes;

text.zh: 5.e. 如果不受2B001.a至2B001.c管制的机床型号中任一轴的“声明的‘单向定位重复性’”等于或小于各机床型号规定的“单向定位重复性”加0.7 µm，则应要求制造商每十八个月重新确认一次精度水平。
text.en: 5.e. If any axis of a machine model not controlled by 2B001.a. to 2B001.c. has a 'stated “unidirectional positioning repeatability” ' equal to or less than the specified “unidirectional positioning repeatability” of each machine tool model plus 0.7 µm, the builder should be required to reaffirm the accuracy level once every eighteen months.

text.zh: 6. 就2B而言，不应考虑国际标准ISO 230-2:2014所定义的机床“单向定位重复性”的测量不确定度。
text.en: 6. For the purpose of 2B, measurement uncertainty for the “unidirectional positioning repeatability” of machine tools, as defined in the International Standard ISO 230-2:2014, shall not be considered.

text.zh: 7. 就2B而言，轴的测量应按ISO 230-2:2014第5.3.2节的试验程序进行。长度超过2米的轴应按2 m分段测试。长度超过4 m的轴需要多次测试（例如超过4 m至8 m的轴测试两次，超过8 m至12 m的轴测试三次），每次覆盖2 m区段，并沿轴长等间距分布。测试区段沿整个轴长均匀布置，剩余长度平均分配于测试区段的前端、区段之间和末端。应报告所有测试区段中最小的“单向定位重复性”值。
text.en: 7. For the purpose of 2B, the measurement of axes shall be made according to test procedures in 5.3.2. of ISO 230-2:2014. Tests for axes longer than 2 meters shall be made over 2 m segments. Axes longer than 4 m require multiple tests (e.g., two tests for axes longer than 4 m and up to 8 m, three tests for axes longer than 8 m and up to 12 m), each over 2 m segments and distributed in equal intervals over the axis length. Test segments are equally spaced along the full axis length, with any excess length equally divided at the beginning, in between, and at the end of the test segments. The smallest “unidirectional positioning repeatability”-value of all test segments is to be reported.

text.zh: “调整峰值性能”（“APP”）技术说明
text.en: Technical Note on “Adjusted Peak Performance” (“APP”)

text.zh: “APP”是“数字计算机”执行64位或更大位数的浮点加法和乘法的调整后峰值速率。
text.en: “APP” is an adjusted peak rate at which “digital computers” perform 64-bit or larger floating point additions and multiplications.

text.zh: 本技术说明使用的缩写
text.en: Abbreviations used in this Technical Note

text.zh: n “数字计算机”中的处理器数量
text.en: n number of processors in the “digital computer”

text.zh: I 处理器编号（i . . . . n）
text.en: I processor number (i . . . . n)

text.zh: t_{i} 处理器周期时间（t_{i} = 1/F_{i}）
text.en: t_{i} processor cycle time (t_{i} = 1/F_{i})

text.zh: F_{i} 处理器频率
text.en: F_{i} processor frequency

text.zh: R_{i} 峰值浮点计算速率
text.en: R_{i} peak floating point calculating rate

text.zh: W_{i} 架构调整系数
text.en: W_{i} architecture adjustment factor

text.zh: “APP”以加权万亿次浮点运算/秒（WT）表示，单位为每秒10^{12}次经调整的浮点运算。
text.en: “APP” is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10^{12} adjusted floating point operations per second.

text.zh: “APP”计算方法概要
text.en: Outline of “APP” calculation method

text.zh: 1. 对每个处理器i，确定“数字计算机”中该处理器每周期执行的64位或更大位数浮点运算峰值次数FPO_{i}。
text.en: 1. For each processor i, determine the peak number of 64-bit or larger floating-point operations, FPO_{i}, performed per cycle for each processor in the “digital computer”.

text.zh: 注
text.en: Note

text.zh: 确定FPO时，仅计入64位或更大位数的浮点加法或乘法。所有浮点运算均须以每处理器周期的运算次数表示；需要多个周期的运算，可用每周期产生的结果分数表示。对于无法对64位或更大位数浮点操作数进行计算的处理器，有效计算速率R为零。
text.en: In determining FPO, include only 64-bit or larger floating point additions or multiplications. All floating point operations must be expressed in operations per processor cycle; operations requiring multiple cycles may be expressed in fractional results per cycle. For processors not capable of performing calculations on floating-point operands of 64-bits or more the effective calculating rate R is zero.

text.zh: 2. 计算每个处理器的浮点速率R
text.en: 2. Calculate the floating point rate R for each processor

text.zh: R_{i} = FPO_{i}/t_{i}。
text.en: R_{i} = FPO_{i}/t_{i}.

text.zh: 3. 按下式计算“APP”
text.en: 3. Calculate “APP” as

text.zh: 4. 对于“向量处理器”，W_{i} = 0.9。对于非“向量处理器”，W_{i} = 0.3。
text.en: 4. For 'vector processors', W_{i} = 0.9. For non-'vector processors', W_{i} = 0.3.
Note 1:

text.zh: 对于一个周期内执行复合运算（例如一次加法和一次乘法）的处理器，每次运算均应计入。
text.en: For processors that perform compound operations in a cycle, such as an addition and multiplication, each operation is counted.
Note 2:

text.zh: 对于流水线处理器，有效计算速率R取流水线填满后的流水线速率与非流水线速率两者中的较快者。
text.en: For a pipelined processor the effective calculating rate R is the faster of the pipelined rate, once the pipeline is full, or the non-pipelined rate.
Note 3:

text.zh: 在求取组合的“APP”前，应按理论上可能达到的最大值计算每个参与处理器的计算速率R。当计算机制造商在该计算机的手册或宣传册中声称可并发、并行或同时操作或执行时，视为存在同时运算。
text.en: The calculating rate R of each contributing processor is to be calculated at its maximum value theoretically possible before the “APP” of the combination is derived. Simultaneous operations are assumed to exist when the computer manufacturer claims concurrent, parallel, or simultaneous operation or execution in a manual or brochure for the computer.
Note 4:

text.zh: 计算“APP”时，不应计入仅限于输入/输出和外设功能（例如磁盘驱动器、通信和视频显示）的处理器。
text.en: Do not include processors that are limited to input/output and peripheral functions (e.g., disk drive, communication and video display) when calculating “APP”.
Note 5:

text.zh: 对于通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O共享连接/设备、I/O控制器及任何由“软件”实现的通信互连而连接或互连的处理器组合，不计算“APP”值。
text.en: “APP” values are not to be calculated for processor combinations(inter)connected by “Local Area Networks”, Wide Area Networks, I/O shared connections/devices, I/O controllers and any communication interconnection implemented by “software”.
Note 6:

text.zh: 对于包含为通过聚合提升性能而“专门设计”、同时运行且共享存储器的处理器的处理器组合，必须计算“APP”值。
text.en: “APP” values must be calculated for processor combinations containing processors “specially designed” to enhance performance by aggregation, operating simultaneously and sharing memory.

text.zh: 技术说明
text.en: Technical Notes

text.zh: 1. 聚合所有同时运行且位于同一裸片上的处理器和加速器。
text.en: 1. Aggregate all processors and accelerators operating simultaneously and located on the same die.

text.zh: 2. 如果任一处理器均可通过以硬件传送缓存行或存储字、无需任何软件机制参与而访问系统中的任一存储位置，则该处理器组合属于共享存储器；这种能力可通过4A003.c、z.1或z.3所列“电子组件”实现。
text.en: 2. Processor combinations share memory when any processor is capable of accessing any memory location in the system through the hardware transmission of cache lines or memory words, without the involvement of any software mechanism, which may be achieved using “electronic assemblies” specified in 4A003.c, z.1, or z.3.
Note 7:

text.zh: “向量处理器”是指具有内置指令，可同时对浮点向量（由64位或更大位数构成的一维数值数组）执行多次计算，且具有至少2个向量功能单元和至少8个每个含至少64个元素的向量寄存器的处理器。
text.en: A 'vector processor' is defined as a processor with built-in instructions that perform multiple calculations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64-bit or larger numbers) simultaneously, having at least 2 vector functional units and at least 8 vector registers of at least 64 elements each.

text.en: 4. When necessary, as determined by the appropriate authority in the exporter's country, details of the component or 'executable software', and details of relevant end-items are accessible and will be provided to the authority upon request, in order to ascertain compliance with conditions described above.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就《密码说明》而言，“可执行软件”是指来自已依据《密码说明》排除于5A002之外的现有硬件部件的、可执行形式的“软件”。
text.en: For the purpose of the Cryptography Note, 'executable software' means “software” in executable form, from an existing hardware component excluded from 5A002, by the Cryptography Note.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: “可执行软件”不包括在最终产品上运行的“软件”的完整二进制映像。
text.en: 'Executable software' does not include complete binary images of the “software” running on an end-item.

text.zh: 《密码说明》的注：
text.en: Note to the Cryptography Note:

text.zh: 1. 要满足注3的a款，必须同时符合以下全部条件：
text.en: 1. To meet paragraph a. of Note 3, all of the following must apply:

text.zh: a. 该物项可能引起广泛个人和企业的兴趣；以及
text.en: a. The item is of potential interest to a wide range of individuals and businesses; and

text.en: b. The price and information about the main functionality of the item are available before purchase without the need to consult the vendor or supplier. A simple price inquiry is not considered to be a consultation.

text.zh: 2. 在判断是否符合注3的a款时，BIS可考虑数量、价格、所需技术技能、现有销售渠道、典型客户、典型用途或供应商的任何排他性做法等相关因素。
text.en: 2. In determining eligibility of paragraph a. of Note 3, BIS may take into account relevant factors such as quantity, price, required technical skill, existing sales channels, typical customers, typical use or any exclusionary practices of the supplier.

text.en: N.B. to Note 3 (Cryptography Note):

text.zh: 对于符合《密码说明》的某些大众市场加密商品和软件，如其对称算法密钥长度大于64位（或对于未实施任何对称算法的商品和软件，5A002.a技术说明2.b所述非对称算法的密钥长度大于768位、椭圆曲线算法的密钥长度大于128位，或采用5A002.a技术说明2.c所述任何非对称算法），必须按照EAR第740.17(b)条要求向BIS提交分类请求或自行分类报告，方可解除ECCN 5A002或5D002的“EI”和“NS”管制。对于根据EAR第740.17(b)和(e)(3)条无需提交自行分类报告的大众市场商品和软件，也解除“EI”和“NS”管制，并转由ECCN 5A992或5D992管制。
text.en: You must submit a classification request or self-classification report to BIS for certain mass market encryption commodities and software eligible for the Cryptography Note employing a key length greater than 64 bits for the symmetric algorithm (or, for commodities and software not implementing any symmetric algorithms, employing a key length greater than 768 bits for asymmetric algorithms described by Technical note 2.b to 5A002.a or greater than 128 bits for elliptic curve algorithms, or any asymmetric algorithm described by Technical Note 2.c to 5A002.a) in accordance with the requirements of § 740.17(b) of the EAR in order to be released from the “EI” and “NS” controls of ECCN 5A002 or 5D002. For mass market commodities and software that do not require a self-classification report pursuant to § 740.17(b) and (e)(3) of the EAR, such items are also released from “EI” and “NS” controls and controlled under ECCN 5A992 or 5D992.

text.zh: USML第XV(f)类以及ECCN 9E001、9E002和9E515不管制向卫星或“航天器”发送或从其接收的真实或模拟数据，条件是该数据仅限于有关“航天器”、“航天器”有效载荷或其相关子系统或部件的健康状况、运行状态、测量或功能信息，或其传感器原始输出。就第9类产品组E而言，此类信息不属于EAR“技术”定义所涵盖的信息范围。此类信息通常称为“状态监测数据”，其示例包括：(i) 与温度、压力、功率、电流、电压和电池电量有关的系统、硬件、部件配置和运行状态信息；(ii) “航天器”或有效载荷的朝向或位置信息，例如状态矢量或星历信息；(iii) 有效载荷的原始任务或科学输出，例如图像、光谱、粒子测量或场测量；(iv) 指令响应；(v) 精确计时信息；以及(vi) 链路预算数据。处理此类遥测数据（即将原始数据转换为工程单位或可读成果）或对其加密的行为，本身不会使遥测数据受ITAR管辖，也不会使其因9A515而受ECCN 9E515管制，或因9A004而受ECCN 9E001或9E002管制。与USML第XV类或ECCN 9A515所管制物项直接相关的所有涉密技术数据，以及使用这些涉密技术数据的防务服务，仍受ITAR管辖。本说明不影响USML XV(f)、ECCN 9D515或ECCN 9E515对用于控制9A515相关“航天器”、有效载荷或相关子系统的软件源代码或指令的管制。本说明也不影响ECCN 9D001、9D002、9E001或9E002对用于控制9A004相关“航天器”、有效载荷或相关子系统的软件源代码或指令的管制。
text.en: USML Category XV(f) and ECCNs 9E001, 9E002 and 9E515 do not control the data transmitted to or from a satellite or “spacecraft,” whether real or simulated, when limited to information about the health, operational status, or measurements or function of, or raw sensor output from, the “spacecraft,” “spacecraft” payload(s), or its associated subsystems or components. Such information is not within the scope of information captured within the definition of “technology” in the EAR for purposes of Category 9 Product Group E. Examples of such information, which are commonly referred to as “housekeeping data,” include (i) system, hardware, component configuration, and operation status information pertaining to temperatures, pressures, power, currents, voltages, and battery charges; (ii) “spacecraft” or payload orientation or position information, such as state vector or ephemeris information; (iii) payload raw mission or science output, such as images, spectra, particle measurements, or field measurements; (iv) command responses; (v) accurate timing information; and (vi) link budget data. The act of processing such telemetry data—i.e., converting raw data into engineering units or readable products—or encrypting it does not, in and of itself, cause the telemetry data to become subject to the ITAR or to ECCN 9E515 for purposes of 9A515, or to ECCNs 9E001 or 9E002 for purposes of 9A004. All classified technical data directly related to items controlled in USML Category XV or ECCNs 9A515, and defense services using the classified technical data remains subject to the ITAR. This note does not affect controls in USML XV(f), ECCN 9D515, or ECCN 9E515 on software source code or commands that control a “spacecraft,” payload, or associated subsystems for purposes of 9A515. This note also does not affect controls in ECCNs 9D001, 9D002, 9E001, or 9E002 on software source code or commands that control a “spacecraft,” payload, or associated subsystems for purposes of 9A004.

text.zh: 第774部分补充文件2——通用技术和软件说明
text.en: Supplement No. 2 to Part 774—General Technology and Software Notes

text.zh: 1. 通用技术说明。商业管制清单物项的“开发”“生产”或“使用”“所必需”的“技术”的出口，按照各类别的规定实施管制。
text.en: 1. General Technology Note. The export of “technology” that is “required” for the “development”, “production”, or “use” of items on the Commerce Control List is controlled according to the provisions in each Category.

text.zh: 受控产品的“开发”“生产”或“使用”“所必需”的“技术”，即使适用于管制程度较低的产品，仍受管制。
text.en: “Technology” “required” for the “development”, “production”, or “use” of a controlled product remains controlled even when applicable to a product controlled at a lower level.

text.zh: 对于符合许可证例外条件或已凭许可证出口的产品，其安装、操作、维护（检查）或修理所需最低限度的“技术”，可适用许可证例外TSU。
text.en: License Exception TSU is available for “technology” that is the minimum necessary for the installation, operation, maintenance (checking), or repair of those products that are eligible for License Exceptions or that are exported under a license.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 这不允许依据许可证例外释放1E002.e、1E002.f、8E002.a或8E002.b所管制的修理“技术”。
text.en: This does not allow release under a License Exception of the repair “technology” controlled by 1E002.e, 1E002.f, 8E002.a, or 8E002.b.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: “最低限度”不包括“开发”或“生产”技术，仅允许在确保产品安全、高效使用“所必需”的范围内提供“使用”技术。各ECCN可对“最低限度”信息的出口进一步限制。
text.en: The “minimum necessary” excludes “development” or “production” technology and permits “use” technology only to the extent “required” to ensure safe and efficient use of the product. Individual ECCNs may further restrict export of “minimum necessary” information.

text.zh: 2. 通用软件说明。对于释放符合以下任一情形的“软件”，许可证例外TSU（大众市场软件）（见EAR §740.13）适用于所有目的地，但EAR第740部分补充文件1中E:1国家组的国家除外：
text.en: 2. General Software Note. License Exception TSU (mass market software) (see § 740.13 of the EAR) is available to all destinations, except countries in Country Group E:1 of Supplement No. 1 to part 740 of the EAR, for release of “software” which is any of the following:

text.zh: 1. 通过以下方式向公众普遍提供：
text.en: 1. Generally available to the public by being:

text.zh: a. 在零售销售点不受限制地从库存中销售，销售方式包括：
text.en: a. Sold from stock at retail selling points, without restriction, by means of:

text.zh: 1. 柜台交易；
text.en: 1. Over the counter transactions;

text.zh: 2. 邮购交易；
text.en: 2. Mail order transactions;

text.zh: 3. 电子交易；或
text.en: 3. Electronic transactions; or

text.zh: 4. 电话交易；并且
text.en: 4. Telephone call transactions; and

text.zh: b. 设计为可由用户自行安装，无需供应商进一步提供实质性支持。
text.en: b. Designed for installation by the user without further substantial support by the supplier.

text.zh: 2.［保留］“公开可获得的技术和软件”见§734.3(b)(3)。
text.en: 2. [Reserved] See § 734.3(b)(3) for “publicly available technology and software.”

text.zh: 3. 对已获准出口物项进行安装、操作、维护（检查）或修理所需最低限度的“目标代码”。
text.en: 3. The minimum necessary “object code” for the installation, operation, maintenance (checking) or repair of those items whose export has been authorized.

text.zh: 3. 通用“信息安全”说明。“信息安全”物项或功能，即使属于其他物项的部件、“软件”或功能，也应依据第5类第2部分的规定审查。
text.en: 3. General “Information Security” Note. “Information security” items or functions should be considered against the provisions in Category 5-Part 2, even if they are components, “software” or functions of other items.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 最低限度的“目标代码”不得增强或提高物项性能，或提供新的特性或功能。
text.en: Minimum necessary “object code” does not enhance or improve the performance of an item or provide new features or functionality.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 通用软件说明不适用于第5类第2部分“信息安全”所管制的“软件”。对于第5类第2部分所管制的“软件”，见第774部分补充文件1、第5类第2部分说明3——密码说明。
text.en: The General Software Note does not apply to “software” controlled by Category 5, part 2 “Information Security”). For “software” controlled by Category 5, part 2, see Supplement No. 1 to part 774, Category 5, part 2, Note 3—Cryptography Note.

text.zh: 第774部分补充文件3——解释声明
text.en: Supplement No. 3 to Part 774—Statements of Understanding

text.zh: (a) 解释声明——医疗设备。为医疗最终用途“专门设计”的商品，若其“集成”的商业管制清单（EAR第774部分补充文件1）商品或软件不具有核不扩散（NP）、导弹技术（MT）或化学及生物武器（CB）管制原因，则归为EAR99，即未在商业管制清单其他条目列明。
text.en: (a) Statement of Understanding—medical equipment. Commodities that are ““specially designed” for medical end-use” that “incorporate” commodities or software on the Commerce Control List (Supplement No. 1 to part 774 of the EAR) that do not have a reason for control of Nuclear Nonproliferation (NP), Missile Technology (MT), or Chemical & Biological Weapons (CB) are designated by the number EAR99 (i.e., are not elsewhere specified on the Commerce Control List).

text.zh: (a)款说明：
text.en: Notes to paragraph (a):

text.zh: (1) “为医疗最终用途专门设计”是指为医疗治疗或医疗实践设计，不包括医学研究。
text.en: (1) “Specially designed for medical end-use” means designed for medical treatment or the practice of medicine (does not include medical research).

text.zh: (2) 商品或软件同时符合以下条件时，视为“集成”：对医疗设备的运行必不可少；通常随医疗设备一并销售；并且随医疗设备一并出口或再出口。
text.en: (2) Commodities or software are considered “incorporated” if the commodity or software is: Essential to the functioning of the medical equipment; customarily included in the sale of the medical equipment; and exported or reexported with the medical equipment.

text.zh: (3) 除依据EAR §734.3(b)(3)公开提供的软件外，“为医疗最终用途专门设计”的商品和软件仍受EAR管辖。
text.en: (3) Except for such software that is made publicly available consistent with § 734.3(b)(3) of the EAR, commodities and software “specially designed for medical end-use” remain subject to the EAR.

text.zh: (4) 对集成商业管制清单中受EAR管辖物项的其他类型设备，另见§770.2(b)解释2。

text.zh: 第774部分补充文件4——商业管制清单审查顺序
text.en: Supplement No. 4 to Part 774—Commerce Control List Order of Review

text.zh: (a) 如EAR §734.3所述，EAR仅适用于“受EAR管辖”的物项，例如不属于其他机构专属管辖的物项。因此，某物项如由《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，22 CFR第120—130部分）的美国军品清单（USML，22 CFR第121部分）描述，包括由其中的兜底条款描述，该物项即为受ITAR管辖的“国防物品”，无需再审查CCL是否描述该物项。见22 CFR §120.6：“国防物品是指ITAR §121.1指定的任何物项或技术数据。§120.3所述政策适用于新增物项的指定。”若USML未描述某物项，且该物项在其他方面“受EAR管辖”，则应依次完成下列各步骤，确定CCL在哪一条目涵盖该物项；如CCL未涵盖，则将其归为EAR99。
text.en: (a) As described in EAR § 734.3, the EAR govern only items “subject to the EAR,” e.g., items not subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of another agency. Thus, for example, if an item is described in the U.S. Munitions List (USML) (22 CFR Part 121) of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120-130), including one of its catch-all paragraphs, then the item is a “defense article” subject to the ITAR and there is no need to review the CCL with respect to whether it describes the item. See 22 CFR § 120.6 (“Defense article means any item or technical data designated in § 121.1 of the ITAR. The policy described in § 120.3 is applicable to designations of additional items”). If an item is not described on the USML and is otherwise “subject to the EAR,” then work through each of the following steps to determine where the item is covered by the CCL or, if it is not covered by the CCL, and is therefore designated as EAR99.

text.zh: (1) 第1步。将“受EAR管辖”的物项与CCL进行归类比对时，首先审查该物项的一般特征。这通常可帮助确定CCL中适当的类别（0至9）。
text.en: (1) Step 1. To classify an item “subject to the EAR” against the CCL, review the general characteristics of the item. This will usually guide you to the appropriate category (0 through 9) on the CCL.

text.zh: (2) 第2步。确定可能适用的CCL类别后，确定该类别或这些类别中的哪个产品组适用于该物项，即A、B、C、D或E。
text.en: (2) Step 2. Once the potentially applicable CCL categories are identified, determine which product group within the CCL category or categories—i.e., A, B, C, D, or E—is applicable to the item.

text.zh: (3) 第3步。“600系列”描述曾受ITAR管辖的军用物项。9x515 ECCN描述曾依据USML第XV类受ITAR管辖的“航天器”、相关物项及某些抗辐射加固微电子电路。如同ITAR实质上优先于EAR，9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN所描述的物项也优先于CCL中的其他ECCN。因此，对“受EAR管辖”物项进行归类分析的下一步，是确定该物项是否由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN中非“兜底”款描述；兜底款例如“.x”款，其管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”和“部件”。若是，即使其他ECCN也描述该物项，该物项仍归入该9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN款。
text.en: (3) Step 3. The “600 series” describes military items that were once subject to the ITAR. The 9x515 ECCNs describe “spacecraft,” related items, and some radiation-hardened microelectronic circuits that were once subject to the ITAR under USML Category XV. Just as the ITAR effectively trumps the EAR, items described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN trump other ECCNs on the CCL. Thus, the next step in conducting a classification analysis of an item “subject to the EAR” is to determine whether it is described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph other than a “catch-all” paragraph such as a “.x” paragraph that controls unspecified “parts” and “components” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. If so, the item is classified under that 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph even if it would also be described in another ECCN.

text.zh: (4) 第4步。若物项未由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN描述，则判断其是否归入9x515 ECCN或“600系列”的兜底款，即管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”的条款。此类物项通常列于ECCN 9A515或某个“600系列”ECCN的“.x”款。
text.en: (4) Step 4. If the item is not described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN, then determine whether the item is classified under a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” catch-all paragraph, i.e., one that controls non-specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. Such items are generally in the “.x” paragraph of ECCN 9A515 or a “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: (i) 第4.a步。判断该物项是否符合EAR §772.1“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准；这些款项通常非正式称为“纳入”款。若均不适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围，跳至第5步。
text.en: (i) Step 4.a. Determine whether the item would meet the criteria of either paragraphs (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition in § 772.1 of the EAR. (These are informally known as the “catch” paragraphs.) If not applicable, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter. Skip to Step 5.

text.zh: (ii) 第4.b步。若物项符合“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准，则判断该定义(b)款的任何规定是否适用；这些规定通常非正式称为“排除”规定。若适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围。
text.en: (ii) Step 4.b. If the item meets the criteria of either paragraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then determine whether any of the provisions of paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition would apply. (These are informally known as the “release” provisions.) If so, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter.

text.zh: (a)(4)款说明：
text.en: Note to paragraph (a)(4):

text.zh: 第4.a步和第4.b步中对“管制”一词的强调具有特定含义。某些ECCN将“专门设计”用作解除管制的参数。若某物项因属于“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)项的范围而不归入某个特定ECCN，则无需分析该定义(b)款的任何要素是否适用于该物项。只有在使用“专门设计”一词的ECCN“管制”款中，“专门设计”定义(a)款适用于该物项时，才需审查该定义(b)款的“排除”规定。
text.en: The emphasis on the word “control” in Steps 4.a and 4.b is deliberate. Some ECCNs use “specially designed” as a de-control parameter. If an item would not be classified under a particular ECCN because it falls within the scope of either subparagraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then there is no need to analyze whether any element of paragraph (b) of the definition would apply to the item. One needs only review the “release” provisions in paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition if paragraph (a) of the “specially designed” definition applies to the item in a “control” paragraph of an ECCN that uses the term “specially designed.”

text.zh: (5) 第5步。若某物项未归入“600系列”或9x515 ECCN，则从产品组开头开始逐一分析各ECCN，判断该产品组中是否有其他ECCN描述该物项。若某ECCN使用“专门设计”一词，分别参见上文(a)(4)(i)及(a)(4)(ii)款中的第4.a步和第4.b步。若这些ECCN之一描述该物项，则归入该ECCN。
text.en: (5) Step 5. If an item is not classified by a “600 series” or in a 9x515 ECCN, then starting from the beginning of the product group analyze each ECCN to determine whether any other ECCN in that product group describes the item. If any ECCN uses the term “specially designed,” see Steps 4.a and 4.b above in paragraphs (a)(4)(i) and (a)(4)(ii) respectively. If the item is described in one of these ECCNs, then the item is classified under that ECCN.

text.zh: (6) 第6步。若CCL任何类别的任何ECCN均未描述该物项，则归为EAR99。若EAR99物项拟供给被禁止或受限制的最终用户、最终用途或目的地，仍可能需要许可证。CCL以外的许可要求，见§732.3“十项一般禁止的相关步骤”第(g)至(n)款，或EAR第736部分的一般禁止四至十。
text.en: (6) Step 6. If the item is not described under any ECCN of any category of the CCL, then the item is designated as EAR99. EAR99 items may require a license if destined for a prohibited or restricted end user, end use or destination. See paragraphs (g) through (n) of § 732.3 “Steps Regarding the Ten General Prohibitions,” or General Prohibitions Four through Ten of part 736 of the EAR for license requirements other than those imposed by the CCL.

text.zh: (xvii) 6A003.b.4——集成“焦平面阵列”、且具有以下任一特性的成像相机：
text.en: (xvii) 6A003.b.4—Imaging cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” having any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.a至6A002.a.3.e的描述所列“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: (A) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.a to 6A002.a.3.e;

text.zh: (B) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.f的描述所列“焦平面阵列”；或
text.en: (B) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.f; or

text.zh: (C) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.g的描述所列“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: (C) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.g.
Note 1:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4所述“成像相机”包括“焦平面阵列”与读出集成电路之外的足够“信号处理”电子电路的组合，使其在通电后至少能够输出模拟或数字信号。
text.en: ‘ Imaging cameras’ described in 6A003.b.4 include “focal plane arrays” combined with sufficient “signal processing” electronics, beyond the read out integrated circuit, to enable as a minimum the output of an analog or digital signal once power is supplied.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.a不管制集成元件数量为12（十二）或更少的线性“焦平面阵列”、未在元件内部采用时间延迟积分，且为以下任一用途设计的成像相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.a does not control imaging cameras incorporating linear “focal plane arrays” with twelve 12 elements or fewer, not employing time-delay-and-integration within the element, and designed for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
text.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

text.zh: b. 用于检查或监测建筑物、设备或工业过程内热流的工业设备；
text.en: b. Industrial equipment used for inspection or monitoring of heat flows in buildings, equipment or industrial processes;

text.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
text.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: d. 为实验室使用“专门设计”的设备；或
text.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use; or

text.zh: e. 医疗设备。
text.en: e. Medical equipment.
Note 3:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.b不管制具有以下任一特性的成像相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.b does not control imaging cameras having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a. 最大帧率小于或等于9 Hz；
text.en: a. A maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 最小水平或垂直“瞬时视场”（IFOV）至少为10 mrad/pixel（毫弧度/像素）；
text.en: 1. Having a minimum horizontal or vertical ‘ Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)’ of at least 10 mrad/pixel (milliradians/pixel);

text.zh: 2. 采用设计为不可拆卸的定焦镜头；
text.en: 2. Incorporating a fixed focal-length lens that is not designed to be removed;

text.zh: 3. 不集成“直视”显示器；并且
text.en: 3. Not incorporating a ‘ direct view’ display; and

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: “直视”是指在红外波段工作，通过集成任何防漏光机制的近眼微型显示器向观察者呈现可视图像的成像相机。
text.en: ‘ Direct view’ refers to an imaging camera operating in the infrared spectrum that presents a visual image to a human observer using a near-to-eye micro display incorporating any light-security mechanism.

text.zh: 4. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: 4. Having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 不具备获取所探测视场可视图像的功能；或
text.en: a. No facility to obtain a viewable image of the detected field-of-view; or

text.zh: b. 照相机仅为单一类型应用设计，且设计为用户不可修改；或
text.en: b. The camera is designed for a single kind of application and designed not to be user modified; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 说明3.b所述“瞬时视场”（IFOV）为“水平FOV”与“垂直FOV”中的较小值。
text.en: ‘ Instantaneous Field of View (IFOV)’ specified in Note 3.b is the lesser figure of the ‘ Horizontal FOV’ or the ‘ Vertical FOV’.

text.zh: “水平IFOV”＝水平视场（FOV）/水平方向探测元件数量
text.en: ‘ Horizontal IFOV’ = horizontal Field of View (FOV)/number of horizontal detector elements

text.zh: “垂直IFOV”＝垂直视场（FOV）/垂直方向探测元件数量。
text.en: ‘ Vertical IFOV’= vertical Field of View (FOV)/number of vertical detector elements.

text.zh: c. 相机为安装于车辆总重小于3公吨（三吨）的民用载客陆地车辆而“专门设计”，并具有以下所有特性：
text.en: c. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle of less than 3 tonnes three tons (gross vehicle weight) and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 仅在安装于以下任一对象中时才可运行：
text.en: 1. Is operable only when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 为其预定的民用载客陆地车辆；或
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 2. 集成主动机制，使相机一旦从其预定车辆上移除即强制停止工作。
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended.

text.en: When necessary, details of the items will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 3.b.4 and Note 3.c in this Note to 6A003.b.4.b.

text.en: 1. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation as an integrated component into indoor and wall-plug-operated systems or equipment, limited by design for a single kind of application, as follows:

text.zh: a. 工业过程监测、质量控制或材料性能分析；
text.en: a. Industrial process monitoring, quality control, or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: b. 为科学研究“专门设计”的实验室设备；
text.en: b. Laboratory equipment “specially designed” for scientific research;

text.zh: c. 医疗设备；
text.en: c. Medical equipment;

text.zh: d. 金融欺诈检测设备；以及
text.en: d. Financial fraud detection equipment; and

text.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
text.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 其预定安装的系统或设备；或

text.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the system(s) or equipment for which it was intended;

text.en: b. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle of less than 3 tonnes (gross vehicle weight), or passenger and vehicle ferries having a length overall (LOA) 65 m or greater, and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 仅在安装于以下任一对象中时才可运行：
text.en: 1. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 为其预定的民用载客陆地车辆或客货汽车渡船；或
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle or passenger and vehicle ferry for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 2. 集成主动机制，使相机一旦从其预定车辆上移除即强制停止工作；
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended;

text.zh: c. 设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c. Limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
text.en: 1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

text.zh: 2. 含有主动机制，在响应限制机制被移除时强制使照相机停止工作；以及
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when the response limiting mechanism is removed; and

text.zh: 3. 并非为水下使用而“专门设计”或改装；或
text.en: 3. Not “specially designed” or modified for underwater use; or

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: d. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 不集成“直视”或电子图像显示器；
text.en: 1. Not incorporating a ‘ direct view’ or electronic image display;

text.zh: 2. 不具备输出所探测视场可视图像的功能；
text.en: 2. Has no facility to output a viewable image of the detected field of view;

text.zh: 3. “焦平面阵列”仅在安装于其预定照相机中时可运行；以及

text.zh: 4. “焦平面阵列”含有主动机制，在从其预定照相机中移除时强制使其永久无法运行。
text.en: 4. The “focal plane array” incorporates an active mechanism that forces it to be permanently inoperable when removed from the camera for which it was intended.

text.en: Supplement No. 7 to Part 774—Very Sensitive List

text.zh: 补充文件7说明：
text.en: Note to Supplement No. 7:

text.zh: 本清单物项虽以ECCN而非《瓦森纳安排》编号标识，其物项描述仍直接取自《瓦森纳安排》的高度敏感清单；高度敏感清单是《瓦森纳安排》敏感清单的子集。若下列ECCN附有文字说明，则高度敏感清单仅涵盖该ECCN项下的一部分物项，或采用不同参数。
text.en: While the items on this list are identified by ECCN rather than by Wassenaar Arrangement numbering, the item descriptions are drawn directly from the Wassenaar Arrangement's Very Sensitive List, which is a subset of the Wassenaar Arrangement's Sensitive List. If text accompanies an ECCN below, then the Very Sensitive List is limited to a subset of items classified under the specific ECCN or has differing parameters.

text.en: (i) 6A001.a.1.b.1—Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having a sound pressure level exceeding 210 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) and an operating frequency in the band from 30 Hz to 2 kHz.

text.zh: (iv) 6A001.a.2.c——为与拖曳式声学水听器阵列实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
text.en: (iv) 6A001.a.2.c—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

text.zh: (vi) 6A001.a.2.f——为与海底或海湾电缆系统实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
text.en: (vi) 6A001.a.2.f—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

text.zh: (viii) 6B008。
text.en: (viii) 6B008.

text.zh: (ix) 6D001——为“开发”或“生产”6B008所列设备而“专门设计”的“软件”。
text.en: (ix) 6D001—“Software” “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 6B008.

text.zh: (xi) 6E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”本补充文件所述6A、6B或6D条款所列设备或“软件”的“技术”。
text.en: (xi) 6E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” of equipment or “software” specified by the 6A, 6B, or 6D provisions described in this Supplement.

text.zh: (xii) 6E002——根据通用技术说明，用于“生产”本补充文件所述6A或6B条款所列设备的“技术”。
text.en: (xii) 6E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment specified by the 6A or 6B provisions described in this Supplement.
(4) Category 7
(5) Category 8

text.zh: (iv) 8D001——为“开发”或“生产”8A001.b、8A001.c.1或8A002.o.3.b所列设备而专门设计的“软件”。
text.en: (iv) 8D001—“Software” specially designed for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 8A001.b, 8A001.c.1, or 8A002.o.3.b.

text.zh: (v) 8E001——根据《通用技术说明》，用于8A001.b、8A001.c.1或8A002.o.3.b所列设备的“开发”或“生产”的“技术”。
text.en: (v) 8E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment specified by 8A001.b, 8A001.c.1, or 8A002.o.3.b.
(6) Category 9

text.zh: (ii) 9D001——为“开发”9A011、9E003.a.1或9E003.a.3.a所列设备或“技术”而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”。
text.en: (ii) 9D001—“Software” “specially designed” or modified for the “development” of equipment or “technology” specified by 9A011, 9E003.a.1, or 9E003.a.3.a.

text.zh: (iii) 9D002——为“生产”9A011所列设备而“专门设计”或改装的“软件”。
text.en: (iii) 9D002—“Software” “specially designed” or modified for the “production” of equipment specified by 9A011.

text.zh: (iv) 9E001——根据《通用技术说明》，用于“开发”9A011或本附件对9D001或9D002的描述所列设备或“软件”的“技术”。
text.en: (iv) 9E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology note for the “development” of equipment or “software” specified by 9A011 or this Supplement's description of 9D001 or 9D002.

text.zh: (v) 9E002——根据《通用技术说明》，用于“生产”9A011所列设备的“技术”。
text.en: (v) 9E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment specified by 9A011.

source.title: 15 CFR Part 774 — The Commerce Control List

title.zh: 先选法律模块，再选语言
title.en: Choose the legal module, then the language

summary.zh: 先选法律模块，再选语言
summary.en: Choose the legal module, then the language

text.zh: 中国模块与美国模块各自独立；中文/英文仅切换同一模块的阅读语言。同一个产品可能需要分别完成两套审查。
text.en: The China and U.S. modules are separate legal systems. Chinese/English changes the reading language within a module. A product may require separate reviews under both systems.

text.zh: 准备商品名称、型号、主要材料/成分、性能参数、软件/技术内容、交易方向、目的地及最终用户/用途。有编码先查编码；无编码先查功能或材料。
text.en: Prepare the item name, model, materials/composition, performance specifications, software/technology content, transaction direction, destination, and end user/use. Search a known code first; otherwise start with function or material.

text.zh: 使用表头筛选箭头，按类别、物项类型、编码、名称、关键词筛选。Ctrl+F可改为搜索整个工作簿。命中只是候选结果；翻译名称和关键词不替代正式条文。
text.en: Use column filters for category, item group, code, name, and keywords. Ctrl+F can search the entire workbook. A match is only a candidate; translated names and keywords do not replace the governing text.

text.zh: 打开条文/子项，连同上级条件、技术注释、定义、排除项及交叉引用一起读。核对“全部/任一”“且/或”、>与≥、单位、纯度及测试条件。
text.en: Open the provision/subitem and read its parent conditions, technical notes, definitions, exclusions, and cross-references. Check all/any, and/or, > versus ≥, units, purity, and test conditions.

title.en: Minutes 7–10: record what remains to be checked

summary.en: Minutes 7–10: record what remains to be checked

text.zh: 记录候选代码、命中子项、技术证据、未确认参数、目的地和用户/用途；完成各模块的交易审查后才能形成许可结论。找不到时扩大关键词并复核附件外规则。
text.en: Record the candidate code, relevant subparagraph, technical evidence, unknown specifications, destination, and end user/use. Complete the module-specific transaction review before reaching a licensing conclusion. If no match appears, broaden the search and check rules outside the attachments.

text.zh: 先按Part 734判断物项/活动是否受EAR管辖，不能只看发货国或品牌国籍。美国境外物项可能涉及美国原产内容最低比例规则或外国直接产品规则，须按具体条件判断。
text.en: Determine whether the item/activity is subject to the EAR under Part 734. Shipment origin or brand nationality alone is insufficient. Items outside the United States may fall under de minimis or foreign-direct product rules, subject to their specific conditions.

title.en: U.S. step 2: determine the ECCN or EAR99

summary.en: U.S. step 2: determine the ECCN or EAR99

text.zh: 依附件4审查顺序、附件2通则、Part 772定义和具体条目确定ECCN及子项。只有受EAR管辖但不列入CCL的物项才使用EAR99；EAR99不是免证结论。
text.en: Use Supplement 4’s order of review, Supplement 2’s notes, Part 772 definitions, and the specific entry to determine the ECCN and subparagraph. EAR99 applies to items subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL; it is not a no-license conclusion.

title.zh: 美国第3步：管制原因与目的地
title.en: U.S. step 3: reasons for control and destination

summary.zh: 美国第3步：管制原因与目的地
summary.en: U.S. step 3: reasons for control and destination

text.zh: 读取适用于该子项的License Requirements，按所列Country Chart列号核对Part 738附件1；同时遵守条目中不依赖国家表的特别要求，并查Part 742。
text.en: Read the License Requirements applicable to the subparagraph and check the specified Country Chart columns in Supplement 1 to Part 738. Also apply entry-specific requirements that operate outside the chart and consult Part 742.

title.zh: 美国第4步：交易主体和用途
title.en: U.S. step 4: parties and end use

summary.zh: 美国第4步：交易主体和用途
summary.en: U.S. step 4: parties and end use

text.zh: 查Part 744最终用户/用途限制及相关名单、Part 746禁运和专项管制，并结合Part 736一般禁止规定。Country Chart未标X、EAR99或民用用途均不能自动跳过这一步。
text.en: Check Part 744 end-user/end-use restrictions and relevant lists, Part 746 embargoes and special controls, and Part 736 general prohibitions. No Country Chart X, an EAR99 designation, or a civilian use does not eliminate this step.

title.zh: 美国第5步：许可证例外或申请
title.en: U.S. step 5: license exception or application

summary.zh: 美国第5步：许可证例外或申请
summary.en: U.S. step 5: license exception or application

text.zh: 有许可要求时，再核对Part 740具体许可证例外全文、§740.2限制、目的地/用户条件及通知、报告、记录义务。满足全部适用条件才可使用；否则评估申请许可及审批政策。禁止交易须另行处理。
text.en: Where a license is required, check the full exception in Part 740, §740.2 restrictions, destination/user conditions, and notification, reporting, and recordkeeping duties. Use an exception only if all applicable conditions are met; otherwise assess licensing and review policy. Address prohibited transactions separately.

text.zh: 中国中文和美国英文保留来源文本；跨语言译文为辅助阅读译文。最终分类应回到对应法域正式文本，重点复核译文中的逻辑连接词、否定词、专门定义及参数。
text.en: The Chinese source text for China and the English source text for the U.S. are retained. Cross-language translations are reading aids. Final classification should return to the governing jurisdiction’s text, especially logical operators, negatives, defined terms, and specifications.

title.en: Actual scope of the added HTML

summary.en: Actual scope of the added HTML

text.zh: HTML包含15 CFR §§774.1、774.2以及Part 774附件1—7：CCL、通用技术/软件注释、理解声明、审查顺序、0Y521临时列管表、敏感清单和特别敏感清单。
text.en: The HTML contains 15 CFR §§774.1 and 774.2 and Supplements 1–7 to Part 774: the CCL, General Technology/Software Notes, Statements of Understanding, Order of Review, 0Y521 entries, the Sensitive List, and the Very Sensitive List.

title.en: The HTML is not the entire EAR

summary.en: The HTML is not the entire EAR

text.zh: Part 734管辖规则、Part 738国家表、Part 740许可证例外全文/国家组别、Part 744名单及最终用途、Part 746禁运、Part 772定义等未在附件中完整提供。工作簿提供入口和解释，不声称已收录全部这些规则。
text.en: The attachment does not provide the full Part 734 jurisdiction rules, Part 738 Country Chart, Part 740 exceptions/country groups, Part 744 lists/end-use controls, Part 746 embargoes, or Part 772 definitions. The workbook provides guidance and links, not complete coverage of those rules.

text.zh: HTML元数据路径使用/on/2026-10-15；这只是展示版本日期。不能据此声称所有条款均于该日生效，或工作簿覆盖截至2026-10-19的全部现行管制。应按交易日期核查修订、过渡和实施安排。
text.en: The HTML metadata uses /on/2026-10-15, identifying the displayed version. It does not establish a common effective date for all provisions or complete coverage of controls in force on October 19, 2026. Check amendments, transition rules, and implementation arrangements for the transaction date.

text.zh: 附件1开头链接至2026年7月23日的91 FR 46261。附件未提供该公告全文；不能仅凭该链接判断修订是否已编入或何时适用。本轮网络工具未能打开该公告正文。
text.en: Supplement 1 links to 91 FR 46261, dated July 23, 2026. The attachment omits the notice’s full text; the link alone does not establish incorporation or applicability. The notice text could not be retrieved through the web tool during this review.

text.zh: HTML编辑注明示：88 FR 71936（2023年10月18日）修订9A005，但由于缺失文字未能编入。涉及9A005须回查该公告和后续更正；不得把当前展示文本标成无保留的完整现行规则。
text.en: An HTML editorial note states that the 9A005 amendment at 88 FR 71936 (October 18, 2023) could not be incorporated because text was missing. Review that notice and subsequent corrections for 9A005; do not represent the displayed entry as unqualifiedly complete current law.

text.zh: 中美有相似类别、技术术语甚至同形代码，但规则来源、范围、阈值、例外和交易限制可能不同。相同代码只可作为跨模块查找线索，不能自动映射为同一管制结论。
text.en: Similar categories, technical terms, and even identical-looking codes may have different legal bases, scope, thresholds, exclusions, and transaction restrictions. A matching code is only a cross-module research lead, not an equivalent classification.

title.zh: 有ECCN是否一定需要许可证？
title.en: Does an ECCN always mean a license is required?

summary.zh: 有ECCN是否一定需要许可证？
summary.en: Does an ECCN always mean a license is required?

text.zh: 不一定。先确认EAR适用，再根据具体子项、管制原因、目的地、最终用户/用途及专项规则判断。
text.en: No. First confirm EAR jurisdiction, then assess the specific subparagraph, control reasons, destination, end user/use, and special rules.

title.en: Does EAR99 mean not subject to the EAR?

summary.en: Does EAR99 mean not subject to the EAR?

text.zh: 不等于。EAR99表示受EAR管辖但未列入CCL；最终用户/用途或目的地限制仍可触发许可。
text.en: No. EAR99 means subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL. End-user/end-use or destination restrictions may still require a license.

title.zh: 美国以外制造、美国以外发货就不用查EAR吗？
title.en: Can I ignore the EAR for items made and shipped outside the United States?

summary.zh: 美国以外制造、美国以外发货就不用查EAR吗？
summary.en: Can I ignore the EAR for items made and shipped outside the United States?

text.zh: 不能。需核对Part 734，包括美国原产内容最低比例规则和外国直接产品规则的具体适用条件。
text.en: No. Review Part 734, including the specific conditions of the de minimis and foreign-direct product rules.

title.en: Can an HS code be directly converted to an ECCN?

summary.en: Can an HS code be directly converted to an ECCN?

text.zh: 不能。本CCL按物项功能、性能和其他条件分类；HS/HTS/Schedule B属于不同用途的海关编码体系。
text.en: No. The CCL classifies items using functions, performance, and other criteria. HS/HTS/Schedule B are customs systems serving different purposes.

title.zh: Country Chart没有X就能直接出口吗？
title.en: Can I ship if the Country Chart has no X?

summary.zh: Country Chart没有X就能直接出口吗？
summary.en: Can I ship if the Country Chart has no X?

text.zh: 不能仅据此判断。还须看条目的特别许可要求、Part 744、Part 746、一般禁止规定及其他适用制度。
text.en: Not on that basis alone. Check entry-specific requirements, Parts 744 and 746, the General Prohibitions, and other applicable regimes.

title.zh: ECCN写GBS Yes就可以直接用例外吗？
title.en: Does “GBS: Yes” authorize immediate use of the exception?

summary.zh: ECCN写GBS Yes就可以直接用例外吗？
summary.en: Does “GBS: Yes” authorize immediate use of the exception?

text.zh: 不可以。它只是条目层面的资格提示；仍须满足Part 740相应例外的全部条件、§740.2限制及交易涉及的其他要求。
text.en: No. It is an entry-level eligibility indication. All conditions of the relevant Part 740 exception, §740.2 restrictions, and other transaction requirements must be met.

title.zh: License Exceptions栏写N/A是否所有例外均不可用？
title.en: Does “N/A” in the License Exceptions section rule out every exception?

summary.zh: License Exceptions栏写N/A是否所有例外均不可用？
summary.en: Does “N/A” in the License Exceptions section rule out every exception?

text.zh: 不宜这样概括。它通常针对该栏列示的具体例外；CCL栏不是所有可能例外的穷尽清单。应查Part 740和其他限制。
text.en: Do not generalize. It generally addresses the particular exception shown. The CCL section is not an exhaustive list of all possible exceptions; consult Part 740 and other restrictions.

title.zh: LVS金额以下是否自动免证？
title.en: Does a value below the LVS amount automatically remove licensing requirements?

summary.zh: LVS金额以下是否自动免证？
summary.en: Does a value below the LVS amount automatically remove licensing requirements?

text.zh: 不自动。除了条目金额限制，还须核对LVS全文的交易、数量/累计、目的地等条件及§740.2；不得只按单张发票金额判断。
text.en: No. Besides the entry’s value limit, check the full LVS transaction, quantity/aggregate, destination, and other conditions and §740.2. An individual invoice amount is not sufficient.

text.zh: 不能。该栏可能指向其他ECCN、ITAR或其他机构权限，影响分类范围和主管制度。
text.en: No. It may refer to other ECCNs, the ITAR, or another agency’s jurisdiction, affecting classification and the governing regime.

title.zh: 引号里的specially designed就是“专门设计”的日常含义吗？
title.en: Does “specially designed” have only its ordinary meaning?

summary.zh: 引号里的specially designed就是“专门设计”的日常含义吗？
summary.en: Does “specially designed” have only its ordinary meaning?

text.zh: 不是。应按Part 772的专门定义和适用条目审查，包括定义中的纳入与排除条件；不能只看营销描述。
text.en: No. Apply the Part 772 definition and the relevant entry, including the definition’s inclusion and release provisions. Marketing descriptions alone are insufficient.

text.zh: 通常不够。标题可能要求查看List of Items Controlled；还需技术注释、相关定义、相关管制和上级条件。
text.en: Usually not. A heading may direct you to the List of Items Controlled. Read technical notes, related definitions/controls, and parent conditions as well.

title.zh: Reserved行表示该类产品完全不受管制吗？
title.en: Does a “Reserved” entry mean the product is uncontrolled?

summary.zh: Reserved行表示该类产品完全不受管制吗？
summary.en: Does a “Reserved” entry mean the product is uncontrolled?

text.zh: 不表示。它是保留位置或已撤销条目的编排标识；还需检查现行其他条目及主管机构。
text.en: No. It is an editorial placeholder or former entry. Review other applicable entries and agency jurisdiction.

title.zh: “See…”交叉引用条目是否就是普通CCL列管条目？
title.en: Is a cross-reference-only entry a normal substantive CCL entry?

summary.zh: “See…”交叉引用条目是否就是普通CCL列管条目？
summary.en: Is a cross-reference-only entry a normal substantive CCL entry?

text.zh: 不一定。§774.1及部分条目保留对其他机构管辖事项的指引；应记录交叉引用状态，沿指引核查。
text.en: Not necessarily. Section 774.1 and some entries retain references to items under other agencies’ jurisdiction. Record that status and follow the reference.

title.zh: 敏感/特别敏感清单是另一套ECCN吗？
title.en: Do the Sensitive and Very Sensitive Lists create separate ECCNs?

summary.zh: 敏感/特别敏感清单是另一套ECCN吗？
summary.en: Do the Sensitive and Very Sensitive Lists create separate ECCNs?

text.zh: 不是。Part 774附件6、7列示特定既有条目或子项；它们不取代附件1的技术范围，可能影响相关许可证例外等规则。
text.en: No. Supplements 6 and 7 identify existing entries or subparagraphs. They do not replace Supplement 1’s technical scope and may affect rules such as license-exception eligibility.

title.en: Is 0Y521 a complete ECCN to report?

summary.en: Is 0Y521 a complete ECCN to report?

text.zh: 0Y521是系列简称；按物项类型使用0A521、0B521、0C521、0D521或0E521，并核对附件5具体物项及其日期条件。
text.en: 0Y521 is a series shorthand. Use 0A521, 0B521, 0C521, 0D521, or 0E521 according to item type and check Supplement 5’s item-specific dates and conditions.

title.zh: 附件里的Country Chart列号在哪里查？
title.en: Where do I check the Country Chart columns?

summary.zh: 附件里的Country Chart列号在哪里查？
summary.en: Where do I check the Country Chart columns?

text.zh: 去Part 738附件1，而不是Part 774。新增HTML未包含该国家表全文；本表只提供规则入口，不能离线自动给出国家许可结论。
text.en: Use Supplement 1 to Part 738, not Part 774. The added HTML omits the chart’s full text; the workbook provides a link, not an automatic offline destination-licensing determination.

title.zh: 图纸或代码没有寄出美国就不算出口吗？
title.en: Is technology or code outside export control if nothing is physically shipped from the United States?

summary.zh: 图纸或代码没有寄出美国就不算出口吗？
summary.en: Is technology or code outside export control if nothing is physically shipped from the United States?

text.zh: 不能这样判断。Part 734涵盖特定技术/源代码的释放、传输及视同出口/再出口；按具体事实和定义核查。
text.en: No. Part 734 addresses certain releases and transmissions of technology/source code and deemed exports/reexports. Assess the specific facts and definitions.

title.zh: 民用、零售或含加密功能能直接决定分类吗？
title.en: Do civilian use, retail availability, or encryption alone determine classification?

summary.zh: 民用、零售或含加密功能能直接决定分类吗？
summary.en: Do civilian use, retail availability, or encryption alone determine classification?

text.zh: 不能。按实际功能、技术门槛、类别5第2部分注释、相关软件/技术条目和适用定义核对；适用大众市场等规则时仍须满足全部条件。
text.en: No. Review actual functions, thresholds, Category 5 Part 2 notes, related software/technology entries, and definitions. Mass-market and similar provisions require all applicable conditions to be met.

title.zh: 2026-10-15就是所有美国条款的生效日吗？
title.en: Is October 15, 2026 the effective date of every U.S. provision?

summary.zh: 2026-10-15就是所有美国条款的生效日吗？
summary.en: Is October 15, 2026 the effective date of every U.S. provision?

text.zh: 不是。它来自HTML版本路径；条款可能有各自生效、合规或过渡安排，且附件存在修订链接与9A005编辑缺口。
text.en: No. It comes from the HTML’s version path. Provisions may have distinct effective, compliance, or transition dates, and the attachment includes an amendment link and a 9A005 editorial gap.

title.zh: 本表能替代实体名单或制裁名单筛查吗？
title.en: Does the workbook replace restricted-party or sanctions screening?

summary.zh: 本表能替代实体名单或制裁名单筛查吗？
summary.en: Does the workbook replace restricted-party or sanctions screening?

text.zh: 不能。新增附件是Part 774，不含完整Part 744或其他机构制裁名单。应按交易日期另查名单、主体身份及适用限制。
text.en: No. The added attachment is Part 774 and does not contain the full Part 744 or other agencies’ sanctions lists. Separately screen parties, identities, and applicable restrictions as of the transaction date.

summary.en: Can I reuse a conclusion when the Chinese and U.S. codes look identical?

text.zh: 不能。分别核对两国条文和交易规则。例如同形代码不保证阈值、排除条款、管制原因或目的地要求相同。
text.en: No. Review each jurisdiction’s text and transaction rules separately. Identical-looking codes do not ensure matching thresholds, exclusions, control reasons, or destination requirements.

text.zh: 回到对应法域来源文本及适用法规，标记翻译疑点；不能用另一个法域的近似条文纠正或替代。
text.en: Return to the relevant jurisdiction’s source text and applicable law, and flag the translation issue. Do not substitute a similar provision from the other jurisdiction.

text.zh: 用于通关商品归类的编号；国家延伸位数可能不同；不等于出口管制代码。

text.zh: 法规编排保留位置；不得据此推断交易不受管制。

text.zh: 须连同Part编号识别，例如Part 738附件1与Part 774附件1完全不同。

text.zh: 1A004的CB表格句子止于“that also have the technical characteristic”，未列出该特征。表内保留这一缺口，不能据此补造条件。

text.zh: 1C002.c.1.a的HTML文字为“109 alloy particles”，该处没有上标标签。中英文保留109并标注核查，不擅自认定为10^9。
text.en: The HTML for 1C002.c.1.a says “109 alloy particles,” without superscript markup at that position. Both languages preserve 109 and flag it for review, rather than assuming 10^9.

text.zh: 2A984的Related Controls使用100m处小于0.1mrad；2D984、2E984的Related Controls使用小于0.5mrad。各条按其原文保留，不统一阈值。
text.en: Related Controls in 2A984 use less than 0.1 mrad at 100 m, while 2D984 and 2E984 use less than 0.5 mrad. Each entry retains its own source threshold.

text.zh: 1C003.b.1原文写作“5 × 104^{−4}”。保留该上标结构，不自行改写数值。
text.en: 1C003.b.1 prints “5 × 104^{−4}.” The superscript structure is preserved without a numerical correction.

text.zh: 1C010定义中的温湿度使用“+”；中英文均保留，不自动替换为±。
text.en: The temperature/humidity notation in the 1C010 definition uses “+.” Both languages retain it rather than replacing it with ±.

text.zh: 1C111.a.2原文尺寸单位写作“60µ”，缺少通常接续的m。按原文保留并提示回查。
text.en: The source for 1C111.a.2 prints “60µ,” without a following m. The notation is retained and flagged for source review.

text.zh: 3A069的GBS栏引用3A999中的RS管制；保留该原文引用，未改为3A069。
text.en: The GBS provision in 3A069 cites RS control in 3A999. The source citation is retained without changing it to 3A069.

text.zh: 1C350关于氟化氢的注释引用1C350.d.14，而同一文件中氟化氢列于d.15。译文保留原引用。
text.en: The hydrogen fluoride note in 1C350 cites 1C350.d.14, while the chemical is listed at d.15 in the same source. The translation retains the source citation.

text.zh: 1C355标题引用“22 CFR parts”但缺少部分编号；未补写。

text.zh: 3A090注1(d)在推定受控的条件中仍使用“below 30/35/40 billion”；与前文解除推定条件的方向存在疑点。中英文保留原阈值方向；不补造2028年条件。
text.en: Note 1(d) to 3A090 uses “below 30/35/40 billion” in the presumption provision, creating a directional concern relative to preceding provisions. Both languages retain the source direction; no 2028 criterion is invented.

text.zh: 9A119标题同时使用“greater than 300 km or greater”；按原文保留，不擅自改为“大于等于300km”。
text.en: The 9A119 heading says “greater than 300 km or greater.” The source wording is retained without changing it to equal to or greater than 300 km.

text.zh: 9A515相关管制段含“UMSL”字样；保留并注明疑似USML拼写问题。
